Interface ClientScreenHandlerAccessor

public interface ClientScreenHandlerAccessor
Borrows ModularUI's global client navigation state for a hosted scope. Save these values before replacing them and restore them on exit. Static bodies deliberately throw: Mixin replaces them at runtime, so invoking untransformed code is an error.
